declaration: Registered after the candidate-pool outcomes and before loading or computing any downstream comparisons for this study. The two family nominees, candidate lists and confirmation membership remain frozen.
model: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, pinned 953dc6f6f85a1b2dbfca4c34a2796e7dde08d41e; FP16 CUDA; original query, original 1200/200 chunks; max_length=8192, batch_size=8; matching file digests in reranker-batching-20261114/protocol.json.
score_sources: Take the original baseline20 paired logits for every incumbent query/chunk, cached historical full-union BGE logits for unseen-within-union pairs and the same real BGE model for every remaining pair. Never impute a score. Validate full historical lane identities, full union coverage, fingerprinted evidence and all source mappings. Report cache-vs-cache exact matches, maximum absolute drift and actual newly scored and reused pairs per cohort.
audit: Before evaluation select the first 16 development and first 64 confirmation queries in frozen cohort order. Score all 20 incumbent and all 20 lexical-refill candidates separately with the production BGE-v2-m3, original arm order and batch size 8. This supplies exact original-order paired inference on 80 queries and an input/precision control on cache reuse. Reuse scores from this audit for missing query/chunk pairs. For remaining queries send all missing chunks for that query to the real adapter together. Report maximum logit drift, exact equal logits and top5 chunk-set/raw5-gold concordance by arm in the audit.
metrics: Rank the 20 blocks by descending BGE logit, descending selector score, chunk ID. Primary downstream guardrail is macro gold coverage in the first five raw reranked chunks. Also document-dedup nDCG@10, Recall@5 and MRR@5. At each stage report gained/lost query-positive pairs, retained baseline pairs, binary full-miss transitions and whether the highest-scoring baseline gold chunk was replaced, even if another chunk of the same source survived. No qrels exist at passage level in BEIR SciFact; do not infer actual passage sufficiency from document IDs.

guardrails.bootstrap: 10,000 paired shared-source-component draws; seed 20261114, 97.5% two-sided percentile intervals on confirmation for family reporting; repeated outcomes and endpoints are reported separately, not a joint test.
guardrails.cache_audit: Require exact top5 chunk set on >=98% of each arm's 80 direct rescored queries, exact raw5 gold sets on all 80 per arm, and maximum cache/direct logit drift <=0.125. If these accuracy checks fail, direct-score every lexical-refill confirmation 20 and use the original baseline20 with same-input drift audit, separately identifying the direct result. Failed direct baseline raw5 gold agreement triggers full direct paired confirmation.
guardrails.efficacy_claim: Claim a delivered raw5 gain only if both point difference and lower bound are strictly positive. A positive pool result alone supports only candidate retrieval.

exposure: Only the pre-selected official TRAIN development and confirmation IDs; no official test or platform HOLDOUT.
